tonight.headline: Behind by 1.96 with your week finished
body: Bad news first: Josh Jacobs left in the first quarter with a hand injury (0.5), and that is the margin. Golden's 32.4 kept it close; Bloodsports finished at 106.96 against Jackrabbits' 108.92.
Every one of your players is done. Jackrabbits still have Tyler Bass kicking for Buffalo tonight; they win unless his misses leave him at -2 or worse. ESPN gives you 1%. There is nothing to do.

case.label: The script that wins it
case.body: Bass misses two kicks and makes none (IPADE scores a miss at -1). That is the whole path.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Bass finishes at -2 or worse — then Bloodsports win and 1% was right to be non-zero.

worthALook.name: Kaleb Johnson
worthALook.lead: Jacobs' replacement Sunday — 14 carries — and a free agent, so he costs no priority.

case.label: The player
case.body: 14 carries, 68 yards, 12.8 at New England after Jacobs' first-quarter hand injury, Strong 8 carries (archive; Athlon 21:56Z carried). Traded for from Pittsburgh ~30 Aug (FantasyNerds). Zero targets.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: If Jacobs sits, Gordon, Tuten and Marks already fill both RB slots and the FLEX. Johnson would be a handcuff, and STRATEGY §4 says never on priority — he is free, but every bench seat is a WR1 or a TE with a job.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jacobs out multiple weeks AND an injury among Gordon, Tuten or Marks — then a free add, dropping Marks only if Montgomery is back.

worthALook.name: Tank Dell
worthALook.lead: 9 targets with Nico Collins playing — a real role back from the knee. On waivers, so it costs priority.

case.label: The player

case.label: Why not now
case.body: IPADE starts Rice and Golden; Wilson and Pickens are hurt but neither is ruled out of Week 10 yet. Priority never resets (STRATEGY §4).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wilson and Pickens both ruled out for Week 10 by Friday — then a third WR is a starter-level need and Dell is the claim, for Pickens' seat only if his hamstring is multi-week.
